manager.title: Operational manager prompt
manager.description: Defines Orbit-wide manager behavior and the required response contract. The selected evaluation-build manager template is inserted at __ORBIT_MANAGER_AI_PROMPT__.
manager.warning: This entire operational manager prompt is Orbit's interpretation contract. Keep its instructions, __ORBIT_MANAGER_AI_PROMPT__ slot, and JSON response format intact; changing or removing any of them can stop evaluations or make results unreadable.
